items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I was not the kind of genius like Max Kaminsky who was able to play and read a song two days after he got a trumpet

ctx.x: I must have taken an hour before I could get some sort of sound out of that horn and my lips were a little sore from trying so hard. Whatever I had learnt when I was 14 and played for a while in the kids band, I had forgotten. But each day when I came home from work, I would take my horn and in a weeks time I was able to play the C scale not too bad.

I was not the kind of genius like Max Kaminsky who was able to play and read a song two days after he got a trumpet and he had never played an instrument before. I began to try and play a number by ear. I didn't know the name of the notes so I would mark on a piece of paper. the fingering of the valves such as 1st and 3rd, 1st and 2nd, 2nd open, etc.

One day I decided to clean inside of the horn and that's when I found out that I had been cheated by the pawn shop where I bought it. I pulled out a slide and the outside of it came off leaving the inner part stuck in the stem. All of the 1/4 joints were the same. I had to take the horn to a music shop and have the parts repaired.
